overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（11 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、模型校准为主。来源分布：arXiv（11 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。

papers.title: Artificial wisdom in gastrointestinal diagnostics: A new frontier in translational reasoning
papers.abstract: Artificial Wisdom represents a paradigm shift in AI-augmented clinical reasoning, integrating historical diagnostic expertise with real-time data, causal inference, uncertainty quantification, and patient-centered decision-making. In gastrointestinal (GI) diagnostics-particularly endoscopy-this approach transcends task-specific pattern recognition to support comprehensive, guideline-aligned decisions about lesion characterization, sampling, and therapy. This mini-review synthesizes the conceptual foundations of Artificial Wisdom and its translational potential in GI endoscopy, highlighting multimodal data integration, causal reasoning, and calibrated uncertainty as pillars of intelligent decision support. We examine current capabilities and limitations of AI systems, propose a three-tier architecture for translational reasoning, and present case-based applications across colorectal polyp management, inflammatory bowel disease surveillance, Barrett’s esophagus, and pancreaticobiliary diagnostics. Implementation challenges-including bias, workflow integration, and regulatory pathways-are discussed alongside research priorities for causally-informed artificial intelligence (AI), human-AI collaboration, and prospective validation. Endoscopy emerges as a proving ground for Artificial Wisdom, offering a pathway to more consistent, equitable, and personalized GI care.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智慧（Artificial Wisdom）代表了人工智能在临床推理领域的一项范式转变，它将历史诊断经验与实时数据、因果推理、不确定性量化以及以患者为中心的决策机制相结合。在胃肠道（GI）诊断领域，尤其是内镜检查中，这种方法超越了传统的任务特定型模式识别，能够支持基于全面信息、符合诊疗指南的决策，包括病变特征分析、样本采集及治疗方案制定。这篇简短综述总结了人工智慧的概念基础及其在胃肠道内镜检查中的应用潜力，重点强调了多模态数据整合、因果推理以及经过校准的不确定性评估在智能决策支持中的作用。我们分析了当前人工智能系统的能力与局限性，提出了一种三层架构以促进这种跨领域推理的实现，并通过实际案例展示了其在结直肠息肉管理、炎症性肠病监测、巴雷特食管（Barrett’s esophagus）以及胰胆疾病诊断中的应用。文章还讨论了实施过程中面临的各种挑战，包括算法偏见、工作流程整合以及相关法规问题，并提出了关于因果推理型人工智能的发展方向、人机协作以及前瞻性验证的研究重点。内镜检查作为人工智慧的试验场，为实现更加一致、公平且个性化的胃肠道诊疗提供了有力支持。。研究方法：因果推断、模型校准。

papers.title: There Ain't No Such Thing as a Free Equilibrium
papers.abstract: I argue that there is a sense in which universal equilibrium (defined loosely) existence in games is incompatible with eschewing strictly dominated strategies and a sense in which it isn't.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我认为，在某种意义上，博弈中普遍均衡（广义定义）的存在与摒弃严格劣势策略是相互矛盾的；而在另一种意义上，这两者并不矛盾。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Stochastic Choice with Distribution-Dependent Preferences
papers.abstract: We develop a continuous-time stochastic choice theory with endogenous preference evolution. Unlike dynamic random utility, observed behavior affects future preferences through the conditional distribution of latent preference states, generating endogenous distributional feedback. We show that this feedback has observable behavioral implications and characterize stochastic choice by a behavioral representation consisting of contemporaneous choice and continuation behavior. This representation is identified from stochastic choice, yields a rigidity result linking structural preference dynamics to observable behavior, and characterizes exactly when distribution dependent utility is behaviorally reducible to dynamic random utility. We further prove a behavioral impossibility theorem: stochastic choice arrays exhibiting behavioral distributional feedback admit no dynamic random utility representation. On the probabilistic side, we establish existence and weak uniqueness for the underlying conditional McKean-Vlasov system with conditional law feedback. The structure unifies endogenous information, latent preference dynamics, behavioral identification, and stochastic choice within a single continuous-time model.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们发展了一种具有内生偏好演化的连续时间随机选择理论。与动态随机效用模型不同，观察到的行为通过潜在偏好状态的条件分布影响未来的偏好，从而产生内生的分布反馈。我们证明了这种反馈具有可观察的行为效应，并通过一种行为表征来描述随机选择过程，该表征包括当前的选择行为以及行为的延续性。这种表征可以从随机选择中识别出来，它揭示了一个将偏好结构动态与可观察行为联系起来的规律性结果，并准确指出了在何种情况下基于分布的效用可以在行为上被简化为动态随机效用。此外，我们还证明了一个行为上的不可能性定理：具有行为分布反馈的随机选择模型无法用动态随机效用模型来表示。在概率论方面，我们证明了具有条件律反馈的McKean-Vlasov系统的存在性和弱唯一性。这一理论框架将内生信息、潜在偏好动态、行为识别以及随机选择统一在一个连续时间模型之中。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Large-Market Discipline in Combinatorial Double Auctions: No Assembly, Bundle Selection, and Complementarities
papers.abstract: We study double auctions for markets in which goods are valuable in bundles, such as data, model weights, and fine-tuned AI assets. A key friction in such markets is No Assembly: a platform may be unable, for legal or technical reasons, to combine components supplied by different sellers into a single bundle. We formulate a combinatorial buyer's-bid double auction under this constraint. Under explicit stability and price-influence conditions (maintained in general, and for two goods derived from local price-taking and a feedback bound), each bundle submarket inherits the large-market discipline of single-good double auctions: bid shading vanishes, and clearing prices concentrate on competitive levels and track the common value (price discovery). The key incentive step, that bidding on a bundle creates no first-order strategic distortion beyond the single-good logic, is proved for two goods; for larger item sets it remains a maintained condition. Multi-agent reinforcement-learning simulations decompose the welfare loss and indicate that No Assembly, not strategic shading, is the binding finite-market friction, with both losses small in moderately thick markets and declining with complementarity amongst goods.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了适用于那些商品需要以组合形式出售的市场中的双边拍卖机制，这些商品包括数据、模型权重以及经过微调的AI资产等。这类市场中的一个关键障碍是“无法组合不同卖家提供的组件”（即No Assembly现象）：由于法律或技术原因，平台可能无法将这些组件整合成一个完整的组合产品。针对这一限制，我们设计了一种基于组合策略的买家出价双边拍卖模型。在明确的稳定性及价格影响条件下（这些条件通常能够得到满足，尤其适用于由局部价格接受行为和反馈机制共同决定的两种商品），每个组合商品子市场都遵循单一商品双边拍卖的基本规则：出价策略中的隐蔽行为（bid shading）会消失，成交价格会集中在具有竞争性的水平上，并能够反映商品的真实价值（实现价格发现功能）。我们证明了对于两种商品而言，组合出价行为不会引入超出单一商品逻辑范围的一阶战略扭曲；对于包含更多商品的情况，这一条件依然成立。通过多智能体强化学习模拟，我们进一步分析了福利损失情况，发现“无法组合不同卖家提供的组件”这一因素才是限制市场有效运行的关键因素，而非出价策略中的隐蔽行为。在商品互补性较强的市场中，这两种损失都相对较小，并且会随着商品互补...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Bartlett Couplings of the Onion and Vine LKJ Samplers
papers.abstract: The extended-onion and C-vine constructions of Lewandowski, Kurowicka and Joe (2009) are standard methods for sampling from the $\mathrm{LKJ}_n(η)$ distribution on correlation matrices. We show that both arise from the simpler row-normalized Bartlett construction associated with the restricted-Wishart representation of Wang, Wu and Chu (2018), which reuses random quantities that the classical samplers regenerate. Two exact row-wise couplings establish this: the squared norm of the Gaussian vector supplying the onion's direction has exactly the Gamma law required for one component of the Beta radius, and the same vector, with one chi-squared variate, generates the entire row of mutually independent C-vine partial correlations with their required symmetric-Beta laws. Under gamma-ratio accounting, normalized Bartlett, the onion, and the conventional symmetric-Beta C-vine require $n-1$, $2(n-1)$, and $n(n-1)$ Gamma-equivalent calls. Controlled benchmarks confirm a low-dimensional advantage over the onion implementation and a persistent advantage over the C-vine implementations examined; direct Bartlett normalization also avoids subtractive complements, moving the small-$η$ zero-diagonal threshold from machine-epsilon scale toward the subnormal range. The sampler is valid for every real $η>0$ and requires only standard normal and chi-squared variates.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】Lewandowski、Kurowicka和Joe（2009）提出的扩展洋葱（extended-onion）与C-vine采样方法，是用于从相关矩阵的$\mathrm{LKJ}_n(η)$分布中抽取样本的标准技术。我们指出，这两种方法实际上都源于Wang、Wu和Chu（2018）提出的简化行标准化Bartlett构造方法，该方法重新利用了经典采样器所生成的随机变量。有两个关键的数学关系证明了这一点：用于确定洋葱方向的高斯向量的平方范数恰好遵循Beta分布所需的Gamma分布律；而同一个向量，结合一个卡方（chi-squared）随机变量，能够生成一整行相互独立的C-vine部分相关系数，这些相关系数同样遵循所需的对称Beta分布律。在考虑Gamma比率（gamma-ratio）约束的情况下，标准化Bartlett方法、扩展洋葱方法以及传统的对称Beta C-vine方法分别需要$n-1$次、$2(n-1)$次和$n(n-1)$次Gamma分布相关的计算操作。控制实验表明，与扩展洋葱方法相比，这两种方法在低维情况下具有明显优势；同时，它们也始终优于其他C-vine实现方式。此外，直...。

papers.title: Strategic Heterogeneity: Welfare Gains from Secession and Immigration
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the strategic and welfare properties of endogenous population partitioning (secession) within large-population anonymous games featuring strategic heterogeneity. We consider a continuum-player framework with a binary action space where players are categorized either as fol- lowers, who experience positive network externalities from conformity, or as contrarians, who seek distinctiveness via anti-conformism. We fully characterize the set of Nash equilibria and establish con- ditions under which costless secession yields structural Pareto improvements. We demonstrate that in any strategically mixed society, every mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium admits a Pareto-improving se- cession. With finitely many types, secession systematically mitigates coordination frictions, enhancing both individual payoffs and aggregate utility. Furthermore, we characterize social planner configura- tions optimizing weighted aggregate utility, establishing a formal mathematical isomorphism between optimal jurisdictional design and the theory of Bayesian persuasion solved via concavification. Finally, we derive the structural conditions governing migration stability when subgroups can unilaterally re- locate across distinct societies.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】本文研究了在具有战略异质性的大型匿名游戏中，内生人口划分（分离）的战略与福利属性。我们采用了一个连续玩家框架，该框架包含二元行动空间：玩家被划分为两类——遵循者（fol-lowers），他们从从众行为中获得正的网络外部性；以及反对者（contrarians），他们通过反从众行为来追求与众不同。我们全面描述了纳什均衡的集合，并确定了在何种条件下无成本的分离能够带来结构性的帕累托改进。我们证明了在任何战略混合的社会中，每个混合策略的纳什均衡都存在一个能够提升帕累托水平的分离方案。当玩家类型有限时，分离能够系统性地减少协调摩擦，从而提高个体收益和总体效用。此外，我们还分析了优化加权总体效用的社会规划配置，并建立了最优管辖设计理论与通过凹化方法求解的贝叶斯说服理论之间的形式化数学对应关系。最后，我们推导出了当子群体能够在不同社会之间单方面迁移时的迁移稳定性所遵循的结构条件。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Fixed-Effect Saturation Is Not Weak Identification: Certifying Inference under Measurement Error
papers.abstract: Fixed-effect saturation alone is not weak identification: in the baseline model, fixed-effect--residualized OLS is unbiased and conventional inference is asymptotically exact for every residual treatment variance $τ^2=nQ_K>0$. Classical measurement error in the treatment restores it, and we derive Stock--Yogo-style critical values for $τ^2$. Under the local drift $σ_ν^2 = c^2/n$, attenuation produces a non-central limit whose non-centrality $η$ decreases in $τ^2$ and, under a treatment-balance condition, depends on the fixed-effect dimension $ρ$ only through an overall $\sqrt{1-ρ}$ scaling, leaving the within reliability $ρ$-free. Inverting the leading quadratic size distortion gives a closed-form threshold; the breakdown reliability has a fixed-point form in the reported $t$-statistic alone. The diagnostic needs only a lower bound on reliability, where bias correction needs a point estimate. We separate a descriptive \emph{point pass} from a \emph{formal certificate}, evaluated at an upper confidence bound and carrying false-certification probability at most $γ$. A cluster-level score CLT and Arellano-variance consistency under a checkable projection-compatibility condition yield $η_{CR}=η/\sqrtψ$. Simulations confirm the threshold; in a saturated democracy--growth panel, aggregate V-Dem polyarchy is certified at $γ=0.05$ while its judicial-constraints sub-index is flagged under i.i.d.\ and clustered errors. The diagnostic covers classical error in a continuous regressor, \emph{not} binary-treatment misclassification.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】仅固定效应饱和性本身并不足以导致识别问题（即无法准确估计参数）：在基线模型中，采用固定效应-残差法（fixed-effect–residualized OLS）的估计是无偏的，并且对于任何残差处理方差 $τ^2=nQ_K>0$，传统的推断方法在渐近意义上都是精确的。当处理变量中存在经典测量误差时，这种无偏性会被破坏；我们为此推导出了基于 Stock–Yogo 方法的临界值。在局部漂移效应 $σ_ν^2 = c^2/n$ 的情况下，误差的衰减会导致非中心极限定理（non-central limit）的出现，其非中心性参数 $η$ 随着 $τ^2$ 的增加而减小；在处理变量平衡的条件下，$η$ 仅通过一个整体缩放因子 $\sqrt{1-ρ}$ 与固定效应维度 $ρ$ 相关，从而使得可靠性参数 $ρ$ 保持独立。通过反转主要的二次项大小畸变（size distortion），可以得到一个封闭形式的阈值；当可靠性参数出现异常时，可以通过报告的 $t$ 统计量来确定问题。诊断过程只需要一个关于可靠性的下限，而偏差校正则需要一个点估计值。我们将描述性的“通过标准”（descriptive \...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Thermodynamic statistics of given names in USA and France
papers.abstract: Using official government data sets of USA and France we analyze the occurrence/frequency/popularity distributions of given names on a time scale of more than 100 years. These distributions are characterized through the Lorenz and Pareto curves broadly used in the analysis of wealth inequality in the world. These curves remain stable during the considered time period with the Gini coefficient remaining in the narrow range 0.85-0.95. As for the case of wealth inequality, we show that the distributions of names are well described by the Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation phenomenon well studied in various physical systems. The RJ thermalization results from two integrals of motion being analogous to energy and probability norm conservation in physical systems with energy states corresponding to popularity levels of names. Time correlations between names are also determined showing their stability until the middle of the twentieth century and a significant change after that.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们利用美国和法国的官方政府数据集，分析了特定名字在超过100年时间尺度上的出现频率/分布情况。这些分布特征通过洛伦兹曲线（Lorenz curve）和帕累托曲线（Pareto curve）来描述，这两种曲线在分析全球财富不平等问题时被广泛使用。在所研究的时期内，这些分布曲线保持稳定，基尼系数（Gini coefficient）始终处于0.85至0.95的狭窄范围内。与财富不平等现象类似，我们发现名字的分布规律也可以用瑞利-金斯（Rayleigh-Jeans, RJ）热化理论来很好地解释，该理论在各种物理系统中都有深入研究。瑞利-金斯热化过程涉及两个积分运算，这些运算类似于物理系统中能量和概率守恒的原理，其中能量状态对应于名字的受欢迎程度。我们还研究了名字之间的时间相关性，发现它们在20世纪中叶之前保持稳定，之后发生了显著变化。。

papers.title: Knowledge-Optimising Investment Decisions with Informative Datasets
papers.abstract: The enormous growth in datasets, both in number and size, has prompted investors to adapt to new ways for assimilating information. Normatively, the approach has been to integrate such datasets into pricing formulations and assess the performance of portfolios created thereafter. However, such approaches underestimate their influence in portfolio investments by limiting their impact to pricing only. While being theoretically valid, this results in a potential sub-optimal performance in the presence of real-life decision constraints, and a blind spot for performance attribution. We start by analysing investment decisions from a knowledge perspective, which unfurls a new structure. We then propose a FinTech process termed Knowledge Optimisation that aims to integrate the influence of knowledge components that could be related to data, models, or business units that extract information. A 3-stage process, namely, decision structure, portfolio selection, and performance assessment is designed. We present an alternative to the ex-ante Sharpe Ratio, integrating a term for knowledge units. Through scenario analysis involving portfolio investment situations, we illustrate the utility. By design, the process improves the importance of knowledge in investment decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着数据集在数量和规模上的急剧增长，投资者不得不适应新的信息处理方式。传统的做法是将这些数据集整合到定价模型中，并评估由此构建的投资组合的表现。然而，这种做法仅将数据集的影响局限于定价层面，从而低估了它们在投资组合中的实际作用。尽管从理论角度来看这种方法是可行的，但在现实决策约束条件下，这种方法可能导致投资组合表现不佳，并且无法准确归因投资组合的表现。我们首先从知识的角度分析投资决策，从而揭示了一种新的分析框架。随后，我们提出了一种名为“知识优化”（Knowledge Optimisation）的金融科技流程，旨在整合与数据、模型或业务单元相关的各种知识因素对投资决策的影响。该流程包括三个阶段：决策框架构建、投资组合选择和绩效评估。我们提出了一种替代传统的“事前夏普比率”（ex-ante Sharpe Ratio）的评估指标，该指标将知识因素纳入考量范围。通过模拟投资组合投资场景的分析，我们展示了这一方法的实际效用。从设计初衷来看，该流程显著提升了知识在投资决策中的重要性。。

papers.title: The Institutional Window: Occupation- and Jurisdiction-Specific Calibration of Liability Signaling for Preserved Human Fallback Capability
papers.abstract: Problem definition. When generative AI produces expert artifacts clients cannot distinguish from a competent provider's, the classical cost-based quality signal collapses and only outcome-contingent commitments can separate types. Such a commitment certifies an endogenous, perishable asset: the human fallback capability a firm builds by keeping staff engaged with cases the AI handles, eroding otherwise. Prior work is silent on where that mechanism holds. We ask where, across occupations and liability institutions, it remains informative.   Methodology/results. We introduce an institutional wedge between the liability cap a firm posts and the retained exposure that carries information, generated by four legal primitives: the cost rule, the enforceability of penalty clauses, the displacement of private liability by state liability or pooled indemnity, and mandatory limits on contractual liability. The wedge compresses the separating type space into a signaling window, bounded above by solvency and the penalty doctrine and below where standard-terms control voids caps beneath a threshold. We calibrate five occupations and seven jurisdictions on published evidence. In common-law agreed-damages channels the provability gross-up is unavailable whenever verifiability falls below 1/m, turning a contracting problem into an operational one. Verifiability investment widens the window where the ceiling binds but narrows it where the cap floor binds. In an agent-based market, within the tested policy class, every empty-window cell converges to zero engagement and skill collapse.   Managerial implications. Liability institutions are a workforce-capability instrument, not merely a risk-allocation device. Firms should target the binding margin in each jurisdiction; cap floors and pooled indemnity each suppress the signal sustaining fallback capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】问题定义：当生成式人工智能（Generative AI）生成出的成果与专业服务提供商的成果难以区分时，传统的基于成本的质量评估机制便失效了，唯有基于最终结果的承诺才能区分这两种成果。这种承诺实际上体现了一种内生的、具有时效性的资产——即企业通过让员工持续参与人工智能处理的工作来培养的“人类备用能力”（human fallback capability）。然而，现有研究尚未明确这种机制在哪些领域仍然具有信息价值。我们的研究旨在探讨这种机制在哪些职业和责任机构中依然能够发挥信息作用。

方法论与结果：我们提出了一种制度性机制，用于分析企业设定的责任上限（liability cap）与实际承担的风险之间的差异。这一差异由四个法律因素决定：成本规则、处罚条款的可执行性、私人责任被国家责任或集体赔偿机制所替代的程度，以及对合同责任的强制性限制。这些因素共同将不同类型的成果区分开来，形成一个信号传递范围。该范围的上限受企业偿付能力及相关法律规定的影响，下限则由合同条款中的免责条款设定。我们根据公开数据对五种职业和七个司法管辖区进行了实证分析。在遵循普通法原则的损害赔偿机制中，当结果的可验证性...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: From Value Bounds to Policy-Distance and Active-Face Certificates: Same-Grid Duality for Constrained Dynamic Portfolios
papers.abstract: Neural and numerical policy solvers can produce feasible controls even when the optimal rule and its binding constraints are unavailable. A primal-dual bracket certifies value loss, but it does not locate the optimal policy or explain which constraints genuinely bind. We show that, on the same declared simulation grid, one bracket can support both conclusions. For polyhedral controls, an exact conditional budget identity rewrites the residual as a pathwise nonnegative terminal Fenchel defect plus date-by-constraint complementary-slackness terms. A canonical Doob compensation removes the budget martingale that obscures small residuals. Bellman-primitive curvature conditions then yield an occupancy-weighted policy region with the sharp O(sqrt(G)) radius, while a paired constraint relaxation lower-bounds the optimal multiplier and certifies a binding face. A finite-sample resolution theorem quantifies the path budget needed to certify a target policy tolerance or face. Locked one-asset and two-asset audits cover every external policy error and make no false face declaration. An exact-wrapper stress test remains tight through 50 assets, while a separate state-dependent pilot identifies learned-dual tightness as the high-dimensional bottleneck. Reference solutions enter only after certification.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】神经网络和数值策略求解器即使在最优规则及其约束条件不可用的情况下，也能生成可行的控制方案。原始-对偶框架可以用来评估价值损失，但它无法确定最优策略，也无法明确哪些约束条件是真正具有约束力的。我们证明了在相同的仿真网格上，一个框架可以同时支持这两种结论的得出。对于多面体控制结构，一个精确的条件预算等式可以将残差表示为路径上的非负终端Fenchel缺陷值，再加上按约束条件划分的互补松弛项。通过Doob补偿方法可以消除掩盖小残差的预算鞅效应。随后，利用Bellman原始曲率条件可以确定一个以占用率为权重的策略区域，其边界半径具有O(sqrt(G))的精确性；而通过放松某些约束条件则可以下界估计最优乘数，并确认具有约束力的策略边界。一个有限样本分辨率定理可以量化验证目标策略容忍度或策略边界所需的路径预算。针对单一资产和双重资产的情况，所提出的审计方法能够覆盖所有可能的外部策略误差，且不会错误地判定策略边界的存在。精确包装应力测试方法在处理50种资产时依然保持有效性；而另一种基于状态依赖性的测试方法则揭示了在高维情况下学习得到的对偶约束条件的紧密性。只有在完成验证之后，才会引入参考解（即已...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Cross-Sectional Heterogeneity in LSTM Networks for Financial Time Series
papers.abstract: Predicting financial asset returns remains one of the most difficult challenges in empirical finance, driven by the low signal-to-noise ratio and the semi-strong form of market efficiency. While deep learning models, especially LSTM networks, have shown promise in capturing temporal dependencies, standard architectures often struggle to account for the cross-sectional heterogeneity of asset returns. This paper proposes a novel architectural extension to the basic LSTM model designed to improve both predictive accuracy and model interpretability. The framework integrates macro-financial covariates to capture broader economic signals and learnable sector embeddings to encompass heterogeneity by sector. The trading strategy involves constructing a long-short portfolio based on daily directional forecasts for each S&P 500 constituent, targeting stocks expected to under- or outperform the cross-sectional median return of the S&P 500. Model Performance is evaluated against three competitive benchmarks: a basic LSTM, a Random Forest model and a traditional market buy-and-hold strategy. The empirical results demonstrate that the LSTM with sector embeddings outperforms all benchmarks across key risk and return metrics. By utilizing sector embeddings, the model explicitly incorporates cross-sectional heterogeneity, allowing it to adapt to varying industry dynamics within the market. To address the black-box nature of deep learning, I use latent space visualizations to analyse how the model differentiates between sectors, providing insights into the internal representation of the sectors in the LSTM. The impact of the sector information can be quantified using a novel contribution metric by inspecting the weights of the LSTM. The predictive signal is driven by a short-term reversal factor and an industry momentum factor.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】预测金融资产回报仍是实证金融领域中最具挑战性的问题之一，这主要是由于信号与噪声的比例较低，以及市场效率遵循“半强形式”（semi-strong form of market efficiency）的假设。尽管深度学习模型，尤其是长短期记忆网络（LSTM），在捕捉时间序列依赖性方面展现出了潜力，但传统模型往往难以解释资产回报的横截面异质性。本文提出了一种对基本LSTM模型的创新架构改进，旨在提升预测准确性和模型的可解释性。该框架整合了宏观金融变量以捕捉更广泛的经济信号，并引入了可学习的行业嵌入（sector embeddings）来反映不同行业之间的差异。交易策略基于对标准普尔500指数（S&P 500）每个成分股的每日方向性预测，构建多空投资组合，选择那些预期表现低于或高于S&P 500指数横截面中位数回报的股票。模型性能通过三个竞争性基准进行评估：基本LSTM模型、随机森林模型以及传统的市场买入持有策略。实证结果表明，结合行业嵌入的LSTM模型在关键风险和回报指标上均优于其他模型。通过利用行业嵌入，该模型能够有效体现资产回报的横截面异质性，从而适应市场内部不同行业的动态变化。为...。研究方法：横截面分析、深度学习、随机森林。
